import ctypes
import os

def assert_test():
    # Load libraries in the correct order
    ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

    # Define prototypes for the functions
    gsl.gsl_ran_hypergeometric.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p), ctypes.c_uint, ctypes.c_uint, ctypes.c_uint]
    gsl.gsl_ran_hypergeometric.restype = ctypes.c_uint

    gsl.gsl_ran_hypergeometric_pdf.argtypes = [ctypes.c_uint, ctypes.c_uint, ctypes.c_uint, ctypes.c_uint]
    gsl.gsl_ran_hypergeometric_pdf.restype = ctypes.c_double

    # Create a GSL random number generator
    gsl_rng_alloc = gsl.gsl_rng_alloc
    gsl_rng_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
    gsl_rng_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)

    gsl_rng_free = gsl.gsl_rng_free
    gsl_rng_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]

    gsl_rng_uniform = gsl.gsl_rng_uniform
    gsl_rng_uniform.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]
    gsl_rng_uniform.restype = ctypes.c_double

    rng_type = ctypes.c_void_p.in_dll(gsl, "gsl_rng_default")
    rng = gsl_rng_alloc(rng_type)

    try:
        # Test case 1: Random number generation
        n1, n2, t = 10, 20, 15
        random_number = gsl.gsl_ran_hypergeometric(rng, n1, n2, t)
        assert isinstance(random_number, int), "Random number must be an integer"

        # Test case 2: Probability density function
        k = 5
        pdf_value = gsl.gsl_ran_hypergeometric_pdf(k, n1, n2, t)
        assert isinstance(pdf_value, float), "PDF value must be a float"
        assert pdf_value >= 0, "PDF value must be non-negative"

        # Test case 3: Edge case with t > n1 + n2
        t = 40
        pdf_value = gsl.gsl_ran_hypergeometric_pdf(k, n1, n2, t)
        assert pdf_value == 0, "PDF value must be 0 when t > n1 + n2"

        # Test case 4: Edge case with k > n1
        k = 15
        pdf_value = gsl.gsl_ran_hypergeometric_pdf(k, n1, n2, t)
        assert pdf_value == 0, "PDF value must be 0 when k > n1"

        print("All tests passed successfully.")

    finally:
        # Free the random number generator
        gsl_rng_free(rng)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
